timestamp: 1 step = 1 hour from 2025-03-01 00:00; odd steps insert a new txn, even steps delete the oldest

frozen_scaling.note: apply log10 to amount_vnd then (x - mean) / std with these constants (computed on card_txn_5d_hard); do not re-fit on the stream

design: Hard segments (diffuse retail, tight night cash-out, overlapping online and retail). Three thin chains of 'hybrid customers' join segment pairs (0,1), (1,2), (0,3). A chain is complete in d0, loses points while the window slides (the oldest points leave first), and the removed run is inserted again later. Natural events from the diffuse segments add to the planted ones; every verified_case comes from reference full re-fits compared as partitions.

case_definitions.Noise: insert; p stays noise, all old labels unchanged
case_definitions.Creation: insert; a new cluster appears made only of p and former noise points
case_definitions.Absorption: insert; p joins exactly one existing cluster (former noise may join too), no merge
case_definitions.Merge: insert; one new cluster contains >= 2 old clusters
case_definitions.Removal: delete; an old cluster loses all its remaining members to noise (cluster vanishes)
case_definitions.Reduction: delete; cluster shrinks or loses cores, but the UpdSeed cores are already directly eps-linked (no connectivity search)
case_definitions.PotentialSplit_NonSplit: delete; UpdSeed cores of an old cluster are not directly linked (search needed) but stay connected
case_definitions.PotentialSplit_Split: delete; an old cluster falls apart into >= 2 clusters
case_definitions.DeleteNoise: delete of a point that was noise (natural streams only)

id_note: point_id never reused. Stream rows carry no missing cells and no duplicates.
ambiguous_note: ambiguous_border_ids lists, AFTER the step, border points within eps of cores of >= 2 clusters; exclude them when comparing labels with a full re-fit. planted_case is filled only on the first event of a planted group that really produced the case; every other event is natural.
